scope: Catalogue handoff driver corrections; neither failure established a product defect. Product-specific studies are linked separately.

attempts.reason: The driver assumed every demo URL ended at /. TraceLens intentionally links to ?example=compare. The actual existing catalogue URL was retained and asserted explicitly.

A Firefox context recorded a ToneMirror font request after disconnect. The font-load barrier ran before the destination recorded-reference group existed. The driver now waits for that group before explicitly loading and awaiting all registered font faces.

The next replay reached TraceLens but axe sampled a partially faded opening bar: composited background #6a7480, while its declared dark-theme final color is #7c8794. The native opening animation lasts 420 ms. The driver now awaits actual document animation completion before its stable-layout audit. It does not change or suppress a contrast rule.
